                 "max_cores": 1}],

 "rationale": "The only frozen work is reading 32 MiB through fd_read, about 4.2 ms. That is below T_R_upper, so no architectural certificate exists. The CRC computation is mutable code, and uutils native runs in 9.85 ms. Whether WebAssembly CRC code without carry-less multiply can finish in the roughly 7.9 ms left within the band is unclear, and I cannot name a specific fix. So this stays a candidate."}
